jury.citizensOnlyLead: Contractors and akimat representatives do not participate in jury voting. Track the milestone status on the contract page.
jury.step1: You vote (Accept/Reject), and your vote is encrypted: SHA-256(vote + salt). The hash is saved in the database.
jury.step2: After everyone has committed their votes, the reveal phase begins. You reveal your original vote and salt.
jury.step3: The smart contract verifies: SHA-256(vote + salt) == hash. If it matches, the vote is counted.
jury.step4: Jurors who voted with the majority receive +10 reputation points. Against — -5.
